name: firebase
description: Official MCP server from Google, lives in firebase-tools. Covers Crashlytics (experimental), Remote Config, App Hosting, Realtime Database, and Cloud Functions logs. Useful for iOS, Android, and web apps that use Firebase.
setup: Requires a recent firebase-tools (v14+ added the MCP surface). `npx -y firebase-tools@latest` always fetches the latest.
Authenticate with `firebase login` before MCP calls hit your project.
If you maintain a long-lived setup, consider `npm i -g firebase-tools` so the MCP server starts faster than `npx` cold-fetch.
Verify the exact subcommand (`experimental:mcp` vs `mcp`) against the homepage — Firebase has been iterating on the surface.
Crashlytics MCP surface is marked experimental by Firebase — expect changes.
